title: Sales Operations Associate
description:
**About Qubix Technologies** 




 Qubix Technologies is a leading provider of Audio Visual (AV), Information Technology (IT), Information Communication Technology (ICT), and Lighting solutions with a legacy dating back to 1984\. We design, build, and support immersive technology ecosystems for living, working, education, hospitality, large venues, and experience spaces across India and the Asia\-Pacific region. Our capabilities span multi\-discipline technology design consulting, system integration, managed services, project execution, and ongoing support — all aimed at delivering seamless, future\-ready audiovisual experiences.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Sales Operations Associate to work closely with our Business Development and Project teams. The role will involve supporting the Business Development team with pricing and commercial requirements, coordinating internally to ensure timely information flow, and working with the Project team on various coordination activities.
 



 This role is ideal for someone with a strong analytical mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work across multiple teams in a fast\-paced project environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work closely with the Business Development team to support pricing, quotations, and commercial requirements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect product, technical, costing, and project\-related inputs required for proposals.
* Assist in preparing pricing sheets, quotations, BOQs, and other commercial documents.
* Maintain pricing data, quotation records, trackers, and other sales\-related documentation.
* Support the Business Development team with proposal revisions, pricing updates, and customer requirements.
* Coordinate with Project teams for project\-related information, updates, documentation, and other operational requirements.
* Ensure timely follow\-up and closure of pending inputs across teams.
* Maintain clear communication between Business Development, Projects, Procurement, Design, and other internal teams.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably from a reputed engineering institution.
* Strong academic background with excellent numerical and analytical ability.
* 0–2 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, Pre\-Sales, Commercial Operations, or a related role. Freshers with strong academic profiles may also be considered.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel and working with numbers/data.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Ability to work with different teams and follow up effectively to meet deadlines.
* Strong willingness to learn and understand technical and commercial aspects of projects.



  





**Life at Qubix** 




 Qubix Technologies is led by Rhythm Arora (CEO \& CTO) (linkedin.com/in/rhythmarora) and Ritika Arora (COO) (linkedin.com/in/ritika\-arora\-a0468132\). The company is driven by a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning, where strong teamwork and clear communication are key to delivering successful projects.
 



 At Qubix, you’ll work on diverse and meaningful technology projects, gain hands\-on exposure to real\-world AV systems, and grow alongside experienced professionals in a supportive environment. We offer competitive compensation, opportunities for skill development, and a workplace where your contributions are valued.

title: Account Manager(B2B)
description:

 Behind every Indian business going global is money they worked hard to earn. But when it’s time to get paid, they wait days and lose
 **3–7% of their revenue** 
 to hidden forex markups and fees nobody explains, just to receive what’s already theirs.
 



  





 We’re fixing this. Skydo gives exporters flat fees, zero forex markup, settlement in hours, and compliance that’s handled for them from start to finish.
 



  





**Join us and help millions of ambitious businesses get paid the way they deserve.** 




  





**About the Job:** 




  





 We are looking for an Account Manager to join our Sales team and drive growth in the Mid\-Corporate (MCG) segment. The Account Manager will own the sales journey from qualified lead to activation and expansion, ensuring customers realize maximum value from Skydo's cross\-border payment solutions.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




  




* Own and validate the sales pipeline end\-to\-end post\-BDR discovery, converting qualified leads into deeply engaged prospects.
* Deliver tailored, solution\-oriented product demonstrations that address specific prospect pain points, driving them toward "Ready to Onboard" (RTO) status.
* Move prospects through the final stages of the sales funnel, securing commitments and actively guiding them through the initial onboarding process to ensure early success.
* Strategically manage post\-activation accounts to identify growth opportunities, driving upsells, cross\-sells, and long\-term revenue expansion.
* Maintain high sales productivity by utilizing CRM tools, precise account mapping, and meticulous call planning to optimize the sales cycle.
* Partner closely with the demand generation and BDR teams, providing actionable insights on lead quality and market feedback to continually optimize the top of the funnel.



  





**You’re a good fit if you have:** 




  




* Strong academic record with approx. 4 years of work experience and at least 3 years in b2b sales.
* Experience with CRM and customer funnel management in B2B. Preferred sectors \- financial services, SaaS / Software
* Sales DNA (target orientation), attention to detail and execution focus
* Understands customer requirements, enjoys building trust\-based relationships

title: Account Executive
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 The Principal Consultant (AE) — Growth is a revenue\-generating, client\-facing role at the heart of Purple Quarter's expansion strategy. You will own the full new\-business cycle: identifying high\-fit companies, opening conversations at the C\-suite and founder level, articulating PQ's differentiated value, and converting them into long\-term clients. This is not a support or coordination role — you carry a number, and you're expected to close.
 



  





 You will engage with founders, CTOs, Heads of People, and VPs of Engineering — often simultaneously at the same account — and must be comfortable holding strategic conversations about hiring strategy, organisational design, and what good tech leadership looks like at scale.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**New Client Acquisition** 



* Build and execute a systematic outbound pipeline targeting high\-growth tech companies across SaaS, fintech, consumer tech, and deep tech.
* Prospect and engage decision\-makers—founders, co\-founders, CTOs, Heads of People — through tailored outreach, warm intros, and ecosystem networking.
* Lead discovery conversations to uncover leadership hiring pain, qualify fit, and position PQ as a strategic partner rather than a vendor.
* Own the full sales cycle from first contact through proposal, negotiation, and signed agreement.



  





**Revenue \& Pipeline Management** 



* Maintain a healthy, weighted pipeline and deliver accurate weekly forecasts against monthly and quarterly targets.
* Consistently hit or exceed new client acquisition and revenue targets.
* Leverage CRM rigorously—every interaction logged, every follow\-up tracked.



  





**Market \& Relationship Development** 



* Build a reputation within the Indian startup ecosystem; become a trusted name in conversations about tech leadership hiring.
* Represent PQ at industry events, founder communities, VC networks, and leadership forums.
* Develop referral relationships with VC partners, PE firms, and ecosystem advisors who can introduce PQ to portfolio companies.
* Share market intelligence and competitive insights with the broader team to sharpen PQ's positioning.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with delivery consultants to ensure a seamless handoff — the client experience should feel continuous from first call to placed hire.
* Collaborate with leadership on BD strategy, pricing approach, and vertical expansion opportunities.
* Contribute to thought leadership content, case studies, and PQ's external narrative as needed.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Non\-negotiables** 



* 5–8 years of B2B enterprise sales or business development experience, with a consistent track record of closing.
* Demonstrated ability to sell to senior stakeholders — CXOs, founders, or board\-level decision\-makers.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; you can distill a complex value proposition into one sharp sentence.
* Structured approach to pipeline management — you know your numbers at every stage without being asked.
* Hunter mentality with high intrinsic motivation; you don't need to be managed into prospecting.



  





**Strong Differentiators** 



* Prior experience in talent advisory, HR tech, or professional services (consulting, SaaS sold into HR/talent buyers).
* Existing networks within the Indian startup and VC ecosystem — warm introductions are a real advantage.
* Understanding of what it takes to hire great technology leaders; you can speak credibly about engineering org design, CTO archetypes, and hiring risk.
* Experience with outbound sequencing tools, CRM hygiene, and data\-driven prospecting.



  





**The Right Mindset** 



* You think like a consultant, not just a seller — you ask good questions and listen for the problem behind the problem.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and can build process where none exists.
* You take ownership personally — if a deal slips, you understand exactly why and course\-correct fast.
* You are genuinely curious about technology, startups, and what makes a great engineering leader.



  





 Interested candidates, please share your resumes at
 **avinash.kodical@purplequarter.com**

description:
**Job Title:** 
 Sales Executive
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Showroom Manager
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Sales Executive is responsible for assisting customers in selecting tiles and related products, providing product information, and closing sales. This role involves understanding customer needs, showcasing product options, and offering professional advice on tile selection and installation. The Sales Executive is expected to provide exceptional customer service, maintain product displays, and achieve sales targets, contributing to the overall growth of the showroom.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Customer Service \& Sales:
* Greet customers as they enter the showroom, offering assistance and product knowledge to guide their purchasing decisions.
* Understand customer requirements by asking the right questions and providing tailored recommendations based on their project needs (e.g., flooring, wall tiles, bathroom tiles).
* Present and demonstrate various tile options, including ceramic, porcelain, vitrified, mosaic, and natural stone tiles, along with complementary products like adhesives and grout.
* Offer product samples, brochures, and detailed information on tile specifications, including durability, size, color, texture, and design patterns.
* Product Knowledge \& Consultation:
* Stay updated with the latest trends, designs, and features in the tiles industry to provide customers with the most accurate and up\-to\-date information.
* Educate customers about product features, benefits, and installation techniques, helping them choose the best tiles for their projects.
* Assist customers in visualizing tile designs using display setups, design catalogs, or digital tools available in the showroom.
* Sales Target Achievement:
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets set by the showroom manager.
* Proactively follow up with potential clients, contractors, builders, and interior designers to generate leads and convert inquiries into sales.
* Upsell and cross\-sell related products, such as tile trims, spacers, sealants, and installation tools, to maximize sales revenue.
* Showroom Maintenance \& Display Management:
* Ensure that the showroom is clean, organized, and well\-maintained, with product displays arranged attractively to showcase the variety of tiles available.
* Regularly update product displays and samples to reflect current stock and new arrivals.
* Monitor stock levels of popular products and coordinate with the inventory team to ensure availability.
* Sales Documentation \& Payment Handling:
* Prepare and process sales orders, invoices, and receipts, ensuring accurate pricing and product details are recorded.
* Assist customers with the checkout process, handling payments, and ensuring a smooth and efficient transaction experience.
* Maintain accurate sales records, update customer databases, and provide daily sales reports to the showroom manager.
* Customer Follow\-Up \& After\-Sales Service:
* Follow up with customer’s post\-purchase to ensure satisfaction with their products and address any questions or concerns.
* Coordinate with the delivery and logistics team to schedule and track the delivery of tiles, ensuring timely and accurate fulfilment of orders.
* Handle customer complaints professionally, providing solutions and escalating issues to the showroom manager if necessary.
* Marketing \& Promotional Activities:
* Participate in showroom promotions, sales events, and marketing campaigns aimed at increasing foot traffic and sales.
* Engage with customers through social media channels or promotional events to enhance brand awareness and customer engagement.
* Provide feedback to the marketing team on customer preferences, popular products, and emerging trends to help shape promotional strategies.


**Qualifications**
* A bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, Master is an advantage.
* 1\-2 years of experience in sales,
* Strong understanding of sales techniques and customer service principles.


**Key Skills**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with customers.
* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to close deals and meet sales targets.
* Good organizational skills, with attention to detail in sales documentation and product displays.
* Basic computer skills, including familiarity with POS systems and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced retail environment.


**Working Conditions**
* Full\-time position, with work hours that may include weekends and holidays, as these are peak times for showroom sales.
* The role may require standing for extended periods and lifting product samples or small inventory items.
* Regular interaction with customers, contractors, and suppliers.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives or commissions.
* Employee discounts on products, healthcare benefits, and opportunities for professional development.
* Opportunities for career growth within the company based on performance.

title: Trainee - Business Development Job
description:
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
   

  

 At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
   

  

**We are looking forward to hire Business Development Professionals in the following areas :**
**Alliance Operations Specialist (Back Office)**
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Back Office Alliance Operations Specialist** 
 to join our team, focusing on our strategic technology partnerships. In this role, you will be the administrative and operational backbone for our relationships with key technology companies like
 **Microsoft, SAP, and ServiceNow** 
 . You'll ensure the seamless execution of our joint initiatives by managing the critical, behind\-the\-scenes tasks that drive our alliance's success. This position is ideal for a detail\-oriented, proactive, and highly organized professional with a strong understanding of the technology sector.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner Onboarding \& Management: Oversee the administrative lifecycle of technology partners, from initial onboarding and account setup to ongoing system and data maintenance in our CRM (e.g., Salesforce).
* Joint Business Planning Support: Assist in gathering, organizing, and compiling performance data, key metrics, and reports for quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with our top partners.
* System \& Tool Administration: Manage partner\-specific portals, dashboards, and internal collaboration tools (e.g., Partner Center, PartnerEdge, etc.) to ensure information is accurate and up\-to\-date.
* Financial \& Royalty Processing: Collaborate with finance teams to accurately track and process partner royalties, incentives, and co\-marketing funds, ensuring all transactions are compliant with alliance agreements.
* Contract \& Agreement Management: Maintain a centralized repository of all alliance contracts, non\-disclosure agreements (NDAs), and statements of work (SOWs), ensuring easy access and compliance.
* Operational Excellence: Identify and implement process improvements to streamline administrative tasks, enhance data accuracy, and increase the overall efficiency of the alliances team.
* Internal Liaison: Act as the main point of contact for internal teams (legal, finance, sales, marketing) regarding partner\-related operational queries.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in a back\-office, administrative, or operational support role, preferably within a technology company or a team that manages technology partnerships.
* Education: A Master of Business Administration (MBA) is preferred.
* Technical Acumen: Familiarity with the technology landscape, and experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel). Experience with partner portals for companies like Microsoft, SAP, or ServiceNow is a significant plus.
* Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills and a meticulous approach to data entry, record\-keeping, and process management.
* Problem\-Solving: A resourceful and proactive mindset with the ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve administrative issues.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact with various internal and external stakeholders.


**Career Path \& Growth Opportunities**
 We believe in nurturing talent and providing a clear path for professional development. For top\-performing team members who consistently demonstrate exceptional results and a deep understanding of our alliances, we offer a direct transition to a front\-facing
 **Alliance Manager** 
 role. These future opportunities may also include
 **international assignments** 
 at our global offices, providing you with a chance to expand your career and experience in key markets.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading technology companies.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.


 At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
   

  

**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**
* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Priority Relationship Manager - NR
description:
**Job Summary**
 As a Relationship Manager, you'll be responsible for managing and developing relationships with clients of International Banking to drive business growth and meet the bank's strategic objectives. You’ll help clients set wealth goals, manage investments, and create portfolios for long\-term growth and stability. You’ll be supported by specialists in the areas of investment, insurance, products and treasury to provide clients with comprehensive solutions.
   

  

 This is an opportunity for you to demonstrate your relationship management, sales, customer service and communications skills. Our Relationship Managers can advance their careers across client segments or explore roles across Wealth and Retail Banking.
   

  

**About Wealth And Retail Banking**
 We service more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.
   

  

 We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross\-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product propositions span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
   

  

 We’re investing USD $1\.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within Standard Chartered Group.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support our clients to meet their financial needs, as they progress through their career and life\-stages.
* Build relationships for the long\-term and understand clients’ financial needs and aspirations to grow, manage and protect their wealth, with appropriate investment solutions.
* Stay ahead of the market and get regular market updates and investment insights from our Chief Investment Office (CIO) to share with clients.
* Leverage myWealth digital and help clients to create custom portfolios, check performance and asset allocation based on CIO’s advice.

title: National Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 Syngenta Seeds is one of the world’s largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High\-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water and fewer inputs.
   

  

 Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions.
   

  

 Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
* Manage and drive the Country P\&L (in terms of Volume, Revenue, and Margins); and NPL as a percentage of Sales
* Identify new areas of growth, evaluate alternate business models to drive future growth
* Manage Sales Fixed Costs and Business Quality thru’ optimising Sales returns \& Collections
* Lead and Motivate the Sales Leadership team of Division Managers to execute sales campaigns \& Business delivery in accordance with the Field Crops Sales Execution Strategy
* Contribute and adhere to the Syngenta commercial policies and pricing structures
* Explore alternate distribution models by Identifying opportunities with strategic partners
* Assume external relationship responsibilities and create a conducive environments for “License To Operate” for the divisions with local regulators and industry stakeholders
* Collaborate with Key stakeholders (Agronomy, Marketing, P\&S and R\&D)
* Act as a single contact point for Monthly Sales Outlooks, Sales \& Operations Plans, Year End Estimates, Sales Execution Strategy and People related matters for alignment in line with overall FC Business aspirations under the direction of the Business Head
* Enable and Coach the Division Managers and High Potential Business Managers
* Develop and maintain a high\-performing Sales organization


**Accountabilities**
* Holistic ownership of the Country Business Objectives
+ Including commercial performance, customer experience, team engagement, external stakeholder commitments

* Create and execute plan for business delivery
+ Focus on sales, profitability, liquidation, collections, market share

* De\-risk business through contingency plans and new opportunities
+ Monitor and drive performances of Channel partners (Distributors, Retailers)
+ Evaluate, assess and expand the Syngenta Pramukh network

* Strong rigour in scale up of New Products through Post Season activity drive and channel engagement in selected blocks
* Lead, Coach and Motivate Division Managers to achieve Division objectives
* Increase Business contribution and profitability through better forecasting
* Actively manage value chain and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Actively manage industry and government relationships
* Ensure Team participation to upgrade Digital Fluency
* Develop Sales and Marketing excellence throughout the Syngenta Enterprise
+ Continually assess capabilities of the Division Managers, Business Managers and Division Marketing Leads
+ Identify gaps in competencies
+ Develop plans to fill gaps
+ Provide best\-in\-class Commercial training to the commercial functions to build and maintain status as trusted local expert.
+ Keep track of developments in agriculture, systematically capture information and bring new innovations to farmers for a competitive advantage.

* Collaborate with key stakeholders for sustainable Business growth:
+ Corporate Marketing for aligning with Product, Pricing and Promotion Strategies
+ Commercial Excellence team for Block strategy, Customer Insights and Channel performance metrics
+ R\&D and Agronomy for faster product delivery in gap segments
+ P\&S and Logistics teams to monitor supply and dispatch plans
+ Finance teams for streamlining Business reports
+ HR team for managing Team capabilities, Policies and People Processes

* People Development
+ Identify talent, recruit, develop, motivate, and provide growth opportunities to team members. Develop performance management plans.
+ Actively manage any performance issues within the team by regular feedback and coaching.
+ Identify technical and people leaders and provide them appropriate opportunities for development and succession planning.
+ Ensure workplace safety and compliance to Syngenta ESH policies
+ Actively demonstrate Syngenta Values and coach team members.

* Active participation in the Field Crops Leadership Team, Sales Leadership Team, HPCs and Division Leadership meetings to ensure alignment and execution of the Sales Strategy in line with country goals, and input into annual and long\-range plans.


**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Experience \& Capabilities**
**Critical knowledge**
* E2E Business Understanding – Commercial, Agronomy, P\&S, R\&D
* Strategic Decision Making and Entrepreneur Mindset
* Expertise in Sales Management, People Management and Building Winning Teams
* Project management capability
* Seed and CP business acumen \- understanding of commercial, Agronomy, Logistics and Distribution
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.


**Critical Experience**
* 10\-15 years of Sales \& Marketing experience in Agricultural or related fields
* Experience in developing teams and participation in strategic teams
* Demonstrated people management potential and coaching others to success


**Critical Technical, Professional And Personal Capabilities**
* Excellent organization and leadership skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Business and Finacial acumen
* Strong interpersonal communication and influencing (with or without authority) skills to work across numerous internal multidisciplinary groups, including Research, Supply chain, Production, Agronomy, Commercial, Regulatory, Intellectual property, etc.
* Self motivation and ability to travel
* Analytical and strategic skills
* Decision making skills
* Capability to acquire scientific and product knowledge.
* Customer orientation and credibility with key stakeholders.


**Critical Leadership Capabilities**
* Result Orientation thru’ Growth Mindset
* Team Leadership, Coaching and Mentoring
* Leading Change
* Championing Diversity \& Inclusion


**Critical Success Factors \& Key Challenges**
* Develop key networks and ways of working for this role
* Effectively position the role as the key for Business Strategy \& Growth initiatives in the BU

title: Associate Director - Entertainment Ad Sales, Digital, LCS
description:
**About The Role**
 You will own strategic relationships with key advertisers and media agencies, driving digital advertising revenue with a high degree of autonomy. You will work directly with brand and agency leadership to shape integrated digital advertising solutions across JioHotstar's premium entertainment ecosystem, operating independently on complex, high\-value engagements. The role requires seasoned commercial judgment, the ability to operate with minimal oversight on strategic accounts, and a track record of building trust\-based relationships with senior client and agency stakeholders. You will report directly to the Pod Leader.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Independently own and grow a portfolio of strategic advertiser and agency relationships, driving digital advertising revenue
* Architect consultative, insight\-led sales strategies aligned to client business and marketing objectives.
* Own the complete sales cycle from prospecting and pitching to commercial negotiations, campaign execution, and post\-campaign reviews.
* Collaborate with Brand Solutions, Revenue Strategy, Product, and Sales Operations teams to deliver impactful client solutions.
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and advertiser spending to identify growth opportunities.
* Identify new business opportunities and onboard new advertisers to the JioHotstar’s ecosystem.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular business forecasts while consistently achieving and exceeding annual revenue targets.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
* 8–10 years of experience in Digital Ad Sales, Media Sales, Brand Partnerships, or Advertising Sales.
* Experience working with digital platforms, OTT, publishers, agencies, adtech or media tech organizations.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including video, programmatic, branded content, sponsorships, and performance marketing.
* Proven track record of managing advertisers and delivering revenue growth.
* Excellent consultative selling, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to engage with senior marketing and agency stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and presentation skills with the ability to translate business challenges into client solutions.
* Self\-driven, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment


**About Us**
 Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
   

  

**What To Know**
* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.


 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
   

  

**About Commvault**
 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI\-powered platform combines best\-in\-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning\-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Senior Sales Engineer (SSE) is a pre\-sales role primarily focused on providing technical sales support to Commvault’s Account managers. The role supports partner\-focused sales teams deploying their skills to influence and drive though the sales cycle. The position requires a strong technical contributor who understands how their decisions impact and influence customer value while at time driving revenue for Commvault. The SSE is seen as a trusted advisor at all levels within an account (C\-Suite, technical stakeholders, etc.). as well as, be a team leader, mentor, teach, and contribute to overall success of Commvault. The SSE drives or supports complex sales opportunities by translating business requirements into solution technical requirements; coordinating technical expertise; sizing, scoping, defining delivery and deployment approach, timeline, and required resources; coordinating demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept; and supporting internal deal acceptance.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…,**
* Work as part of the account team to formulate and produce territory plans, account strategies, and sales plans including engaging specialist resources for accounts determined by the Sales and SE Manager. SE will as well develop new opportunities within the assigned territory.
* Anticipate technology trends and successfully build strong relationships with partners and internal departments (sales, support, business units, product management, marketing, development), as appropriate, to ensure success during sales campaigns and/or to ensure the customer experience is extremely positive.
* Embrace calling on senior level IT leadership often without account executive present at the same time and engage with the customer to qualify and understand key technical, financial, operational, and business issues that can be addressed with any one or all of Commvault products.
* Proactive in building relationships with technical decision makers within end\-user accounts and driving detailed, executable Technical Account Plans for all focus targets and current customers utilizing Commvault Target Account Selling methodology for both open opportunities and ongoing customer satisfaction.
* Distill the pre\-sales discovery into a concise message, outlining the salient technical, business, operational, and financial inefficiencies/challenges that Commvault addresses with its products.
* Collaborate with the creation and presentation of a business case to any and all business sponsors (i.e., C\-level executives, technical partners, etc.) in support of the Commvault solution.
* Propose and professionally demonstrate Commvault products through the use of presentations, existing customer solutions, white board, demo’s, pilots, "proof\-of\-concepts", etc.
* Actively participate in all Sales and regional meetings, QBRs, adding value and technical leadership on all topics (field marketing, qualifying, etc.).
* Provide technical expertise and enablement support for the channel and alliance partners as needed.
* Continuously develop and maintain technical and market expertise through training, certifications, conferences, etc.
* Keep senior management and relevant internal groups informed of key issues and changes which may impact expected business results through business reviews and Salesforce.com documentation.
* Provide feedback on potential product or process improvements to appropriate internal groups and participate where necessary in formulating innovative solutions.


**Who you are ?**
* 5\+ years in the Data Protection, or cloud experience; Minimum 8\+ years of experience serving in a pre\-sales systems engineer role.
* Demonstrates solid experience delivering, presenting, selling, supporting Enterprise Client
* Provides strong competitive knowledge of e.g. Commvault, AWS, AZURE, GCP, Storage,Symantec NBU, EMC Networker, EMC Avamar, IBM TSM, VEEAM, Symantec Enterprise Vault, , etc.
* Proven strong experience selling, conducting Proof of Concept (POC), architecting data management solutions (backup and recovery, data migration, replication, compliance, SRM, etc.).
* Ability to work in a rapid growth environment where priorities, roles and responsibilities are continuously updated to meet market and customer demands.
* Experienced in participating in and building teams of specialists to support customers and sales cycles to successful outcomes.
* Basic knowledge with common Software licensing practices (cloud, perpetual, term, maintenance)
* Specialized knowledge/skills and demonstrated proficiency with at least one major open systems operating system, hypervisor or cloud.
* Enterprise application exposure or knowledge of SAP, Oracle, Exchange, db2, SharePoint, etc.
* Solid knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as storage, servers, networking, cloud , hyper\-convergence, etc.
* Requires strong consultative selling skills which pair product expertise with business, industry and competitive acumen. Solid experience with business case creation and TCO modeling are definite pluses for this role.
* Success penetrating and managing a minimum of three major accounts (Fortune 500\-1000
* Excellent written, presentation, and communication skills; ability to build and maintain business relationships.
* Ability to work in an organized, procedural manner using tools such as Salesforce.com to facilitate process and information organization.
* BS or MS degree in Computer Science/engineering or related and proven technical field experience in IT industry preferred.
* Sales methodology experience (TAS, SPIN, Solution Selling, Challenger, etc .)
* Able to work remotely and autonomously
* Travel up to 50%


 Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.
   

  

 Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com.

description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in\-depth regulatory know\-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end\-markets that include Human Health \& Nutrition, Home \& Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints \& Coatings and Wood Protection.
   

  

 With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024\. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R\&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.
   

  

 This job is responsible for sustainable and profitable growth of a mix of BLs business across India by leading commercial strategy, developing key customer relationships and identifying market development opportunities. The role is accountable for achieving sales and profitability targets, managing receivables and serving as the primary commercial interface between customers and internal stakeholders. Through strong market intelligence, customer engagement and cross\-functional collaboration, the position supports strategic decision making, strengthens competitive positioning and delivers long\-term business value.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions:**
* Owns commercial performance across the assigned market, delivering sales, profitability and growth objectives. Drives margin improvement through disciplined pricing, value selling, cost management and effective management of receivables and working capital.
* Develops and executes strategic account plans for key customers, builds long\-term relationships and ensures high standards of customer responsiveness, technical support and service excellence.
* Identifies, develops and converts new business opportunities within existing and adjacent markets. Supports and guides distribution partners to drive profitable growth and maximize market penetration. Maintains opportunity pipelines and CRM discipline.
* Acts as the market expert by monitoring competitors, market trends, regulatory developments and technology changes. Provides market insights and demand forecasts to support business planning, S\&OP and strategic decision\-making.
* Collaborates with Marketing, Product Management, R\&D and Operations to influence product development, pricing and supply priorities. Represents the region in global and regional initiatives, product launches and strategic discussions.
* Manages reporting, compliance requirements, internal meetings, training, travel, process improvements and other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Education should be Graduate / Bachelor any discipline
* 8\+ years sales experience in chemical sector, preferable Paints \& Coatings.
* Strong sales/Business development skills
* Sound understanding of specialty chemicals and market dynamics, and the ability to develop strategic customer relationships
* Strong negotiation, communication, analytical and influencing skills are essential, along with the ability to interpret market trends, manage complex sales opportunities and collaborate effectively across functions
* Able and willing to work from company premises (Mumbai) and /or home office; frequent travel


 Arxada has world class offering in two distinct areas:
   

  

**Microbial Control Solutions (MCS)** 
 focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home \& Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints \& Coatings and Material Protection.
   

  

**Nutrition, Care \& Environmental (NCE)** 
 provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high\-performance applications.

**Job Description About Arjo**
 Arjo provides medical equipment and solutions for hospitals and elderly care markets, including pressure area care, patient handling, and diagnostic equipment. We are a market leader in medical equipment rentals and capital equipment sales, operating under ISO 13485 certified Quality Management System.
   

  

**Employer Arjo (ArjoHuntleigh Healthcare India Pvt Ltd)**
 ArjoHuntleigh Healthcare India Pvt Ltd, a 100% subsidiary of Arjo AB Sweden is operating in India for the last 25 years and employing over 200 people in 39 cities. The company deals with products in Pressure Injury Prevention, Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Prevention, Medical Beds and Patient Handling; in addition to holding a significant presence in the Diagnostics segment with products like Patient Monitors, Fetal Monitors and Dopplers. The company has pioneered the concept of rental sales in Corporate Hospitals of India with the products that it offers. The company commands a leadership position in the product segments that it operates in and enjoys the trust of Doctors and Nurses in over 1000\+ major hospitals in India.
   

  

**Department : Sales** 
**Role Purpose**
 Drive sales of medical equipment and rental solutions to large corporate hospitals, ensuring revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and compliance with regulatory and quality standards .
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Drive revenue growth by managing and expanding sales of medical equipment, rentals, and consumables across assigned hospital accounts. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, lead product adoption through clinical engagement, and collaborate cross\-functionally to deliver high\-quality, compliant healthcare solutions while identifying new business opportunities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Sales Achievement \& Market Expansion
* Achieve annual sales targets and manage Accounts Receivable for the assigned territory.
* Identify new customers, develop high‑growth markets, and expand territory presence.
* Upsell and cross‑sell to existing customers, including rentals and consumables.
* Launch new products and drive their adoption in key hospitals.
* Key Account \& Stakeholder Management
* Develop and execute account strategies for key hospitals.
* Build strong networks with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) — doctors, nurses, biomedical staff, and hospital executives (COO, CFO, CEO, CNO).
* Maintain strong relationships with C‑suite and other key decision‑makers.
* Collaborate with hospital project consultants on new projects.
* Customer Engagement \& Product Support
* Lead effective product demonstrations and engage stakeholders to create awareness of how Arjo solutions address critical healthcare needs.
* Work closely with the clinical team on product trials, evaluations, and successful adoption.
* Grow and maintain long‑term customer relationships.
* Market Intelligence \& Risk Management
* Monitor competitor activity and develop appropriate mitigation strategies with manager.
* Capture customer feedback, escalate quality‑related issues promptly, and support risk management documentation for equipment deployment.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with internal teams — Clinical, Marketing, Service, and Finance — to align on market strategies and ensure smooth execution.
* Support sustainability initiatives aligned with Arjo’s corporate responsibility goals.


**Experience** 
 : Average of 3\-5 years of experience in Medical Equipment Sales/ Medical Devices Sales/Specialty Pharmaceutical product sales / Hospital Sales .
   

  

**Qualifications** 
**:** 
 Science/ Engineering Graduate / Non\-Science Graduates holding a Full Time MBA.
   

  

**CTC Offered:** 
 As per market standards
   

  

**About Arjo**
**At Arjo, we believe that empowering movement within healthcare environments is essential to quality care. With over 6500 people worldwide and 65 years caring for patients and healthcare professionals, we are committed to driving healthier outcomes for people facing mobility challenges.**

**www.arjo.com**

* We want to be the company that is a friendly insurance \& health partner not just a service provider, who just takes over, who are super easy to use and super smooth to work with


1. **We will learn from our customers \- We handle more diverse customers than you can imagine and from them our AMs learn and become rock\-stars.**

**Global Sales** 
 at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000\+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector \& small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**Job Family Definition**
 Manages one or several larger accounts or acts as the account lead for a substantial part of a top account. Understands the customer’s IT and business objectives, priorities, requirements and challenges, and adds value by implementing HPE’s strategy. Drives business performance for all HPE BUs and manages the portfolio mix to optimize profitability of the account. Accountable for pipeline building; accountable for and supportive in deal closing and orchestrating the deal team. Builds and develops relevant customer relationship networks with key influencers and decision makers in IT and business. Develops and engages with the extended partner ecosystem to maximize HPE’s presence in the account. Constantly develops information technology industry knowledge to position HPE’s portfolio in the account. Orchestrates, engages, guides and provides feedback to the extended account team members. Acts as customer’s advocate inside HPE. Plans for accounts to deliver results through the financial year and beyond.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and methods. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross\-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do:**
* Articulates a two\-way connection between the customer's core KPIs, business priorities and initiatives, and the plan to support the customer with IT solutions. Influences the decision\-making of customer executives through describing the value of HPE's solutions and their relevance to the customer's priorities. Positions HPE strategy and solutions in such a way that the customer sees that HPE is critically important to their business. When appropriate, understands the innovation agenda and digital journey of the customer, and provides input into them. Builds a business value framework for the customer.
* Builds and executes a plan to drive growth and profitability across HPE's portfolio, in a structured and recurring way. Drives growth in HPE's strategic value portfolio through positioning these solutions with the customer. Formulates and presents technology choices for the customer that will expand HPE's presence and margin in the account. Leverages HPE programs and tools (e.g. Executive Sponsors, BU deal support, and supply chain programs) to improve business performance. Contributes to internal reviews connected to deals and sales planning.
* Engages with the customer to identify opportunities. Translates customers' business challenges and goals into IT opportunities. Ensures a strong and rightsized pipeline funnel from the account team. Leads pipeline building activities for the account, involving account team members as appropriate. Identifies and develops opportunities for short and mid\-term success. Proactively leads early engagements. Accountable for deal closure. Ensures ownership throughout the team for the deals in the pipeline. Drives deals to closure through a multi\-disciplinary team, including partners.
* Develops and maintains a professional relationship network within the customer to maximize efficiency and effectiveness for HPE. Understands and leverages the underlying principles for the customer organization's functioning. Builds influential relationships with executives. Defines an effective engagement model with the customer's key influencers and decision makers.
* Develops and maintains a view of the partner landscape in the account. Develops partner relationships. Runs an active governance process for the partner network for the account. Works with the Partner Business Manager to assess and update the partner strategy for the account.
* Develops and updates expertise in IT technology. Engages as appropriate with the customer's CTO/CIO. Articulates relevant modern trends in IT and presents them to executives within the customer when appropriate. Describes HPE's portfolio and references its use in other customers.
* Builds, develops and leads the extended account team. Runs a governance with the extended team and empowers account team to engage on different levels within the account. Establishes a recurring process to provide feedback to the account team members and the relevant managers.
* Provides feedback into other HPE organizations and coordinates with other customer facing HPE organizations to improve the customer experience. Utilizes HPE tools and processes for customer advocacy. Leverages the existing tools, processes and resources to assure customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Develops and executes a comprehensive account business plan for defined accounts. Manages the collective effort to build and maintain both strategic and tactical elements of the plan. Shares and aligns the plan with relevant stakeholders of the account.


**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience:***
* University or Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or equivalent experience. Engineering or technology education, advanced degree or MBA desired.
* Typically 6\-10\+ years account management experience.
* Experience in IT industry preferred. Experience working within an IT department and/or working within customers is a plus.
* Experience in vertical industry preferred.
* Experience in different sales roles is a plus.


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Drives Results: Shows strong will to win, is persistent in face of obstacles and has a clear results orientation.
* Strategic Planning: Able to skillfully articulate a vision for the future and a path to achieve it in an account business plan, aligned with the HPE strategy, direct leadership, and the HPE business units.
* Sales Execution: Able to efficiently deliver on short term sales engagements and objectives.
* Continuous Learning: Continuously and actively pursues own learning.
* IT Industry Acumen: Builds and maintains thorough knowledge of cutting edge IT industry developments and technology trends with potential impacts to our customers.
* HPE Portfolio Knowledge: Builds and continually updates a thorough understanding of HPE products, solutions, and service offerings \- their value propositions, competitive differentiators, and benefits to our customers and our customers' customers.
* Team Leadership: Skilled at leading teams (including dispersed and indirect team members) successfully through sales engagements in a complex matrix organization.

* Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
* Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

* Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) , Blue Beam

title: Channel Partnerships (Senior Associate / Assistant Manager)
description:
**Senior Associate / Assistant Manager \- Channel Partnerships**




  





 📍
 *Delhi \| Own and scale college and university partnerships to drive on\-ground activations, lead generation, and enrolments for Kraftshala’s placement\-oriented programs.* 




  





**The Short Version**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 We’re looking for a Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Channel Partnerships who thrives in high\-ownership, on\-ground roles to build partnerships from scratch and driving real enrolment outcomes. You should be comfortable operating independently, travelling frequently, and engaging senior stakeholders like TPOs, deans, and faculty to create win\-win collaborations.
 



  





**What the role is about:** 
 You’ll build and scale Kraftshala’s offline acquisition engine by forming partnerships with colleges and institutes across India, starting with Delhi NCR. Your work will directly influence lead flow, enrolments, and revenue, making this a
 **core growth role** 
 \- not a support function.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 




  




* Opportunity to build a partnerships channel from scratch and scale it nationally
* Clear linkage between your work and enrolment/revenue outcomes
* Direct exposure to senior leadership on GTM decisions



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rates, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The Detailed Version**




  





 You will own on\-ground partnerships with colleges, universities, and training institutes to drive awareness and enrolments for Kraftshala’s placement\-oriented programs. This is a field\-heavy, individual contributor role requiring frequent travel, strong stakeholder management, and sharp execution.
 



  





 While the initial focus will be Delhi NCR, deployment will be opportunity\-led with pan\-India scope over time.
 



  





**Specific Responsibilities \& Metrics:** 




  




* Build and manage institutional partnerships.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Number of active college/institute partnerships; depth of engagement per partner; repeat collaborations*
* Plan and execute on\-ground seminars, workshops, and events.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Number of events conducted; attendance quality; lead yield per event*
* Generate and hand over qualified leads to the Admissions team.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Leads generated; lead qualification rate; successful handover and follow\-through*
* Own relationships with TPOs, deans, and faculty stakeholders.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Stakeholder responsiveness; partnership longevity; referral introductions*
* Track performance and pipeline using CRM tools.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*CRM hygiene; reporting accuracy; visibility of funnel and outcomes*



  





**Monthly Outcomes**




  





**Month 1:** 



* Onboard fully on Kraftshala’s programs, value proposition, and admissions funnel
* Activate existing college/institute contacts
* Close initial partnerships and execute early seminars/events



  





**Month 2:** 



* Build a predictable cadence of events and partnerships
* Improve lead quality and handover effectiveness
* Identify high\-performing partner profiles and formats



  





**Month 3\+:** 



* Scale partnerships across new geographies based on opportunity
* Drive consistent contribution to enrolments and revenue
* Act as a feedback loop to leadership on on\-ground GTM insights



  





**Top Grading**




  




* **Ownership \& Accountability:** 
 An A\-player independently builds and scales partnerships end\-to\-end, whereas a B\-player waits for direction and external momentum.
* **Stakeholder Influence:** 
 An A\-player earns trust with senior academic stakeholders and creates repeat collaborations, whereas a B\-player struggles to move beyond transactional conversations.
* **Execution Excellence:** 
 An A\-player consistently converts on\-ground activity into qualified leads, whereas a B\-player confuses effort with outcomes.
* **Data Discipline:** 
 An A\-player maintains clean CRM data and clear reporting, whereas a B\-player treats tracking as an afterthought.



  





**Must Haves:**




  




* 2\-5 years of experience in B2B business development. (
 *We are not too fussed about the number of years. Experience is simply a proxy for capability, which is what we really care for* 
 ).
* Comfortable with field\-heavy roles and frequent intercity travel
* Proven ability to generate, track, and hand over qualified leads
* Working knowledge of CRM tools and outcome reporting



  





**Good to Haves:**




  




* Prior experience engaging with TPOs, deans, and faculty members
* Existing college or university relationships that can be activated immediately



  





**Selection Process:**




  





 As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes. Typically the whole process takes between 10 \- 15 business days depending on your and our schedules.
 



  




* **Setting Expectations:** 
 This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
* **Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
* **Conversation 1:** 
 This will be with our Head of Admissions wherein you can expect to be evaluated on the competencies needed for the job (mentioned above).
* **Conversation 2:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the
 *Kraftshala Kode* 
 .
* **Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.



  





**Location:**




  





 Delhi
 



  





***Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.***

**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.**

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  





 "
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 This role is responsible for driving sales performance and execution across regions through meticulous planning, monitoring, and team development. Key responsibilities include preparing weekly and monthly sales targets, validating doctors' potential, creating doctor\-product matrices, and conducting regular reviews with ASMs and TMs. The role involves ensuring effective implementation of medico\-marketing activities, managing customer relationships, and resolving operational challenges. Additional duties include enabling ASMs to train TMs, overseeing territory potential mapping, and ensuring accurate customer classification and visit frequency. The position requires adherence to COBE guidelines, process monitoring (e.g., call coverage, RCPA, and e\-detailing), and collaboration with cross\-functional teams (SFE, SCM, GSA, PMT) for seamless operations and problem\-solving. A critical focus is on developing and implementing strategies to turn around low\-performing areas and fostering a high\-performance culture across the team.

* Led Rx business of revenue size of minimum USD 3 million or its geographical equivalent for a minimum of 2 areas in the country and/or could be in a KAM role in B2B pharma sales, managing revenues of minimum of USD 800K or its geographical equivalent.

title: Manager - Corporate Sales & Memberships
description:
Maniac Sportz runs 19 venues and 41 courts across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and Thane. Our flagship, Maniac Pickleball Arena at Vile Parle West, has 12 covered courts and never closes. We are looking for our first dedicated corporate sales hire.
 



  





 The job in one line: fill courts that never close, by selling to the companies, societies and schools within 5 km of them.
 



  





 What you'll own
 



 Corporate accounts. Offices in Vile Parle, Andheri, BKC and Goregaon that need offsites, team events, wellness programmes and Friday\-evening leagues. You find them, pitch them, close them and keep them.
 



 Memberships. Turn one\-time players into monthly members. Build the packages, price them with the founder, sell them.
 



 Bulk and block bookings. Housing societies, schools, academies, corporate tournaments. Our quiet hours \- weekday mornings and late nights \- are your inventory.
 



 The pipeline itself. There is no CRM today. You will set one up and run it.
 



 Renewals and referrals. A member who brings three friends is worth more than three cold leads. Build that loop.
 



  





 What we are looking for
 



 2\-5 years in B2B sales, memberships, hospitality, events or fitness. Sport is a plus, not a requirement \- we can teach pickleball, we cannot teach hustle.
 



 You are comfortable walking into an office lobby without an appointment.
 



 Mumbai\-based, and you actually know the western suburbs.
 



 Fluent in English and Hindi. Marathi helps.
 



 Comfortable being measured on a number every month, and willing to work some evenings and weekends. That is when a sports venue is alive.
 



  





 What you get
 



 Fixed salary plus uncapped commission on everything you close.
 



 Direct reporting to the founder. No layers, no politics, decisions the same day.
 



 First sales hire, which means you shape the function rather than inherit it.
 



 Free court access and coaching. Obviously.
 



  





 Who this is not for
 



 If you want a defined territory, a mature playbook and a manager who checks in weekly, this is the wrong job. This role is closer to founding a sales team than joining one.
 



  





 How to apply: apply through LinkedIn and tell us, in three lines, about the hardest thing you have ever sold. We read every one.

 Sun Pharma is looking for a National Sales Manager (NSM) – Corporate Hospital Business to lead and drive the growth of its Corporate Hospital Business across India.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for business strategy, market\-share growth, key hospital partnerships, institutional sales excellence, portfolio expansion and execution across the national hospital ecosystem. The incumbent will work closely with Sales teams, Marketing, Distribution and other cross\-functional teams to build a strong, sustainable and future\-ready hospital business.
   

  

 This is a strategic leadership role requiring deep expertise in the exclusive hospital business, strong commercial acumen and established relationships with senior hospital stakeholders, particularly Procurement, SCM and Purchase leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* National Business Leadership


 Own and drive the national Corporate Hospital Business, with accountability for growth, profitability, market share and business performance.
   

  

 Develop and execute annual business plans, forecasts, budgets and growth strategies for the hospital channel.
   

  

 Identify opportunities for geographical expansion, deeper hospital penetration and business development across Metro, Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.
   

  

 Track market dynamics, competitive landscape and regional performance, translating insights into actionable business strategies.
   

  

 Drive sustainable growth through strategic account management and institutional business development.
   

  

* Corporate Hospital Business


 Lead business development across large corporate hospital chains, standalone hospitals, trust accounts.
   

  

 Build and strengthen strategic relationships with senior hospital decision\-makers and key stakeholders.
   

  

 Establish strong engagement with hospital SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial leadership.
   

  

 Drive hospital empanelment, formulary inclusion, explore business opportunities with new brand inclusions.
   

  

 Develop and manage strategic relationships with key hospital networks and purchasing organisations.
   

  

 Ensure strong execution of hospital\-specific business plans and account strategies.
   

  

* Strategic Account Management


 Develop a robust Key Account Management framework for top corporate hospital groups and strategic institutions.
   

  

 Map decision\-making structures and build relationships across hospital management, procurement, SCM, Purchase, clinical stakeholders and other influencers.
   

  

 Identify and unlock new business opportunities within existing and emerging hospital networks.
   

  

 Drive long\-term partnerships with key institutional customers rather than transactional business relationships.
   

  

* Portfolio Expansion \& New Product Launches


 Identify portfolio gaps and market opportunities within the hospital channel.
   

  

 Work closely with Marketing, distribution and Sales teams to develop a competitive hospital portfolio and channel strategy.
   

  

 Drive launch excellence and new product availability across key institutions.
   

  

 Ensure effective product placement, availability and execution within hospitals.
   

  

 Monitor supply chain performance and proactively address product availability and service challenges.
   

  

* Team Leadership \& Capability Building


 Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing national hospital business team comprising regional/zonal and frontline teams.
   

  

 Build capabilities in institutional selling, strategic account management, hospital access, negotiation and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 Establish a strong performance culture with clear objectives, review mechanisms and accountability.
   

  

 Develop talent and succession capability for the hospital business.
   

  

* Cross\-Functional \& Stakeholder Management


 Partner closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, Medical, Sales and Digital teams to deliver business objectives.
   

  

 Drive effective coordination between commercial strategy and operational execution.
   

  

 Represent the organisation at relevant hospital forums, industry platforms, conferences and strategic customer engagements.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to company policies, compliance standards and established SOPs.
   

  

* Digital \& Data\-Driven Business Excellence


 Drive adoption of CRM, analytics and digital tools across the hospital business.
   

  

 Use business intelligence and performance dashboards to identify opportunities, track execution and improve productivity.
   

  

 Build data\-led approaches to customer segmentation, account prioritisation, forecasting and business planning.
   

  

 Identify opportunities for technology\-enabled hospital engagement and future\-ready business models.
   

  

**Travel Estimate**
 80%
   

  

**Job Requirements**
**Educational Qualification**
 Graduate in Science/Pharmacy; MBA/PGDM preferred.
   

  

**Experience**
 Minimum 10 years of exclusive Pharma Hospital Business experience.
   

  

 Mandatory minimum 5 years of exclusive Hospital Business experience in a National role or having handled minimum 3 zones out of 4 zones in Pan India leadership role.
   

  

 Only candidates with exclusive Hospital Business experience should apply.
   

  

 Well\-versed with the top\-end corporate hospital ecosystem and senior hospital management.
   

  

 Established relationships with senior stakeholders in SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial functions of leading hospitals.
   

  

 Strong understanding of the Indian hospital ecosystem and corporate hospital business models.
   

  

 Proven track record of delivering business growth, strategic account development and large institutional business

 This is not a traditional Executive Assistant or administrative role. The person will represent the CFO’s office in external interactions, build relationships with key stakeholders, identify business opportunities and ensure that important conversations progress into meaningful outcomes.
   

  

 The role is suitable for a fresher or an early\-career professional who wants direct exposure to senior leadership, business development, partnerships and strategic execution.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain relationships with corporate leaders, government stakeholders, industry bodies, institutional partners and other relevant decision\-makers.
* Identify potential business opportunities, partnerships, pilots and strategic collaborations.
* Support the CFO in preparing for meetings, stakeholder interactions and business discussions.
* Coordinate meetings, demonstrations, proposals and follow\-up conversations with prospective partners.
* Conduct research on organisations, sectors, decision\-makers and emerging opportunities.
* Prepare meeting briefs, presentations, proposals, partnership notes and progress updates.
* Maintain a structured tracker of stakeholders, conversations, commitments and next steps.
* Follow up consistently with internal and external stakeholders to keep opportunities moving.
* Work with product, technology, finance and leadership teams to convert business requirements into actionable proposals.
* Represent the company professionally at meetings, conferences and networking events.
* Provide the CFO with clear and timely updates on ongoing discussions, risks and required interventions.
* Take ownership of selected strategic initiatives from initial conversation through execution.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Strategy, Finance, International Business or a related field.
* Fresh MBA graduates and candidates with up to two years of experience may apply.
* Strong communication, presentation and relationship\-management skills.
* Confidence in interacting with senior executives, government officials and institutional stakeholders.
* Ability to conduct research, understand business requirements and communicate them clearly.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and the ability to manage multiple conversations simultaneously.
* High level of ownership, discretion and professional maturity.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment with evolving priorities.

title: Sales Executive - Bangalore
description:
Prakruti Plus is a Social Business Model in the Catalyst Management Services platform, built to make climate\-smart solutions commercially available to small producers and low\-income households. It brings proven technologies — cold chain, clean cooking, solar and allied products to the last mile through a network of community entrepreneurs and collective enterprises. Prakruti Plus therefore combines product supply, financing linkage and after\-sales support resulting in improved livelihoods and healthy days.
 




**Purpose of the role** 





 Drive primary and secondary sales of Prakruti Plus climate solutions through the community organisations, FPCs, cooperatives or SHG federations.
 





 The role owns revenue conversion at the last mile: turning demand generated on the platform into paid orders, realised collections and repeat purchase.
 




**Scope of work** 





 1\. Sales delivery
 



* Own the sales funnel end to end ; lead generation, demonstration, quotation, negotiation, order closure, delivery coordination , collection, after sales service and insight generation on additional products required by the community.
* Convert institutional and aggregated demand into confirmed orders.
* Maintain a live, stage\-wise pipeline




 2\. Channel and franchisee activation
 



* Recruit, onboard and activate community entrepreneurs and channel partners; support them until they reach independent selling capability.
* Ensure community organisation unit economics are explained and understood — commission structures, margins and payment terms
* Run periodic channel reviews covering stock position, ageing, dormant agents and dropout reasons.




 3\. Customer and market intelligence
 



* Capture competitor pricing, product gaps, objections and rejection reasons and feed these back to the business and to innovator partners.
* Validate whether stated customer willingness to pay converts into actual payment, segment by segment.




 4\. Financing linkage
 



* Work with the inclusive finance and cooperative arms of the platform to structure affordable payment options where product cost exceeds customer liquidity.
* Coordinate with financing partners on documentation and disbursement.




 5\. Data discipline 
 



* Record every lead, visit, quotation and closure in the platform data system within the agreed cycle.



**Deliverables** 



* Monthly sales and collection report against plan, by product and by channel.
* Active pipeline dashboard, refreshed weekly.
* Quarterly territory plan: target segments, named accounts, channel additions, expected conversion.
* Post\-sale service and satisfaction feedback for a sample of customers each quarter.
* Quarterly market intelligence note covering pricing, competition, product performance and adoption barriers. Community feedback on other products required.



**Performance indicators** 



* Order value and volume closed
* Number of active, transacting channel partners
* Conversion rate from qualified lead to closed sale
* Repeat purchase rate and referral\-led sales
* Data completeness and timeliness
* Customer complaint resolution turnaround



**Person specification** 





 Essential
 



* Three to six years in field sales, preferably rural or semi\-urban distribution — agri\-inputs, appliances, solar, dairy equipment, FMCG or micro\-finance and with community organisations, FPCs, cooperatives or SHG federations.
* Demonstrated record of closing sales and recovering payments
* Comfort with commercial arithmetic: margins, landed cost, EMI, customer break\-even.
* Kannada and English; Tamil or Telugu an advantage depending on territory.
* Willingness to travel 15–20 days a month.
* Familiarity with CRM or mobile data capture tools.
* Exposure to credit\-linked or subsidy\-linked product sales.
